coverage.assessment: Two setups are lost. The 'east' longing that motivates p7's 'back to the east' is gone, and the clause about Adams's opinion of politicians that grounds 'explained everything' (p16) is gone. The begonia, Niagara, and three-readers setups all survive.
'The future attracted him less' has lost its comparison with reliving youth. 'They pursued it' in p3 has no clear antecedent. Time, place, and voyage sequence are otherwise clear.
Brice's quip is correctly tied to Cleveland and applied to Harrison. Lamar's formula is attributed to Lamar. Hay's Boutwell exclamation is kept as performed speech.
King remains 'still in doubt'. The 'perhaps' and 'if defect it were' hedges are kept. The Niagara gloss is accurate per Ch. 010. The 'pursuit of money' gloss matches the source's referent.
The wife and her death are not mentioned, and the figure's occasion stays unexplained. The retrospective 'Education had ended in 1871' framing survives intact.

The revision trimmed several distinctive turns: the teacher-as-criminal line, the Sinai wilderness, and Hay's book-thieves. The first draft had already cut the Rock Creek closing irony. The triads and semicolon chains largely survive.

The case that Hay was used but never rewarded now rests on assertion alone. The Rock Creek passage loses its universal-commonplace evidence and its final layman, priest, and soldier gradation. The mirror principle itself is intact.
All four dependencies are intact at both endpoints in the revised drafts of 021, 010, 027 and 022.

dependencies.assessment: The local begonia hose image is verbatim. Chapter 021's revision keeps Howe's begonia simile and its gloss as showy but not useful.

evidence.quote: as though playing a garden hose on a thirsty and faded begonia.
of likening him to a begonia.

dependencies.assessment: The Niagara ratio is kept with a light gloss as the steamer of his first diplomatic crossing. Chapter 010's revision keeps the Niagara at East Boston.

evidence.quote: measured against the old Niagara that had carried him on his first diplomatic crossing.
crawling down to the wretched old Cunard steamer Niagara at East Boston to start again for Liverpool.

dependencies.assessment: The mirror principle is verbatim, and the figure is unexplained. Chapter 027's revision keeps 'One sees what one brings' with Gibbon.

evidence.quote: Like the others, the priest saw only what he brought. Like all great artists, St. Gaudens held up the mirror and no more.
One sees what one brings, and at that moment Gibbon brought the French Revolution.

dependencies.assessment: King's result remains 'still in doubt', and no ruin is narrated. Chapter 022's revision keeps the 'die at eighty the richest' prophecy.

evidence.quote: King had followed the ambitious course. He had played for many millions.
With ordinary luck he would die at eighty the richest and most many-sided genius of his day.

findings.claim: The first draft cut p4's reverie of reliving youth, so 'The future attracted him less' has nothing to be less than. The revision then deleted the wish to go 'back to the east' in the trade-winds. As a result, p7's 'the easiest path led back to the east' arrives with no stated longing behind it, and 'east' for the Pacific is unexplained.
findings.counterevidence: 'South Seas' is named in p5, so a careful reader can infer what 'east' means.

evidence.quote: He could always amuse himself by living over his youth, and driving once more down Oxford Street in 1858
Adams would rather, as choice, have gone back to the east, if it were only to sleep forever in the trade-winds
Adams would rather have gone back to the east, if it were only to sleep forever in the trade-winds under the southern stars.
The future attracted him less. He had just come up from the South Seas with John La Farge
He was ready to quit the world, and the easiest path led back to the east

findings.minimal_repair: Restore the first draft's one-sentence 'Adams would rather have gone back to the east…' and a short clause on amusing himself by living over his youth.
findings.plan_relation: Paragraph 5 was optional for compression, not deletion of its motivating clause. Cutting p4's details is allowed, but this leaves a dangling residue.
findings.reader_effect: Readers lose the past-versus-future hinge and may find 'east' confusing after a South Seas reference.
findings.title: London/South Seas transition: dangling comparative and unprepared 'east'

findings.claim: The source says Adams's opinion of politicians lacked enthusiasm, and that he explained everything by Grant as a type. Both drafts drop the opinion clause. 'Everything' therefore has no referent, and the reference leans on omitted Grant chapters.
findings.counterevidence: Chapter 021's revision keeps Grant as an inarticulate, money-awed type, which partly supports the allusion. The full global setup is unresolved because 019–020 are omitted.

evidence.quote: Adams's opinion of politics and politicians, as he frankly admitted, lacked enthusiasm
Adams explained everything by his old explanation of Grant's character as more or less a general type
Adams explained everything by his old explanation of Grant's character as more or less a general type

findings.minimal_repair: Prefix: "Adams's opinion of politics and politicians, as he frankly admitted, lacked enthusiasm, and he explained everything by…"
findings.plan_relation: Planning omission: Chapters 019–020 are cut, so this allusion needs a local anchor.
findings.reader_effect: The sentence reads as an unmotivated allusion. Readers cannot see that 'everything' means politicians' conduct.
findings.title: 'Explained everything' by Grant's character lacks its subject

findings.claim: The revision deleted the sentence naming the teacher as worst criminal, with the world dragging the student off course. 'The moral is stentorian' now follows only the generic conspiracy clause. Both drafts had already cut the closing claim that even the fittest waste three-fourths of their energy.
findings.counterevidence: The essential 'society conspires to waste mind' survives.

evidence.quote: No doubt the teacher is the worst criminal, but the world stands behind him and drags the student from his course.
No doubt the teacher is the worst criminal, but the world stands behind him and drags the student from his course. The moral is stentorian.
society has conspired to promote it. The moral is stentorian.

findings.reader_effect: This causes a small stumble in the twenty-year summary. The self-deprecating note that there were 'no very glittering prizes' is also lost.

findings.claim: The revision removed the counterfactual sequence: a mission under Hayes, the Cabinet under Garfield, restoration by Harrison. It also cut Hay's book-thieves sentence from the profit-and-loss section. Hay's side of the ledger is therefore thinner.
findings.counterevidence: The essential 'used but never given office' and 'laughing at himself' both survive.

evidence.quote: Had usefulness to the public service been ever a question, Hay should have had a first-class mission under Hayes
Had usefulness to the public service been ever a question, Hay should have had a first-class mission under Hayes
but they never needed him in equivalent office.

findings.minimal_repair: Optionally restore the single 'Had usefulness…' sentence.
findings.plan_relation: This is an optional-adjacent compression within the essential office section.
findings.reader_effect: The irony of Hay being 'always used' loses its concrete proof. However, the core claim that he was never given equivalent office remains.

findings.claim: Both drafts cut the claim that any Asiatic would read the figure at a glance. They also cut the final gradation down to the 'half-witted soldiers' who wanted the money spent on drink. The paragraph now ends on the layman/priest balance.
findings.counterevidence: The Sphinx-to-Shelley list and the mirror principle carry the meaning without explaining the figure.

The American layman had lost sight of ideals; the American priest had lost sight of faith.

findings.counterevidence: The essential points survive: lost worship, wasted money, and ignorance of the past.

and the American people seemed to have no clearer idea than they. They had lost the sense of worship

findings.minimal_repair: Optionally restore the first draft's Sinai sentence.

findings.title: Sinai wilderness image removed from the worship argument

strengths: All eight verbatim anchors survive in context, including the Niagara ratio and the closing 'dead men' punchline.
The Rock Creek passage keeps the source's silence about the figure's occasion while preserving its 'oldest commonplace' framing and the mirror principle.
Brice's Cleveland quip, the extension to Harrison, the King Log and King Banker fable, and Lamar's formula are all kept with correct attribution and comic timing.
King's wave-length joke and the hedged American/English 'in the blood' passage keep Adams's self-ironizing qualification.
summary: The revision keeps the chapter's architecture, all eight verbatim anchors, every continuity check, and the deliberate silence about the Rock Creek figure. All four planned dependencies survive at both ends. The remaining problems are small dangling residues from compression. The opening London and South Seas transition lost its comparative and its 'east' setup. The 'Grant's character' explanation lost its antecedent. A pronoun in the twenty-year summary dangles. The revision also made a few voice-thinning cuts, including the teacher-as-criminal aphorism and the Sinai image. None of these is a blocker; they call for small editorial repairs.
